q: What should a GHG verification statement contain?
title: What a verification statement contains
short: Who verified what, against which standard, at what level of assurance, and their conclusion. A usable statement names the organisation and period, the emissions verified by scope, the criteria such as ISO 14064-1 or the GHG Protocol, materiality, the verifier's independence, and any qualifications or exclusions.
audience: Companies receiving or reviewing verification statements

ul: Scope 1, Scope 2 and any Scope 3 totals verified.
Qualified or unqualified conclusion, with reasons.
A conclusion with no stated level of assurance.
Totals that differ from the report it refers to.

p: Send buyers the statement with the report it covers, so they can match the numbers.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
